newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Int'l again postpones press conference.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Int'l again postpones press conference.

text.p: Bankrupt Kiwi International Air Lines Monday postponed until later this week a press conference to outline its return to scheduled service.
Kiwi spokesman Rob Kulat said the press conference was postponed due to scheduling conflicts with major media organizations. A new date has not been scheduled.
Today's cancellation marks the second time Kiwi postponed announcing plans to return to service.
Kiwi suspended operations October 15, after filing for Chapter 11 bankrupcty on September 30.
The airline previously said it hopes to resume scheduled flights by November 20.
